_about: t26 (card experiments/t26_one_long_run/, D91): ONE long from-scratch training of the one-frame, one-scan recursive network with the EfficientViT-B1 image student trainable on live images of EVERY frame of the window. Differences from t25_rec_scan.json (recursive camera, ONE radar sweep, batch 2 x accum 3, n_cam 3 / cam_stride 2, GT v13 / lane l6): no init_from (the base is not warm-started; trunk_pretrained as t20_base), split xl (700 / 82 scenes, the xl caches under data/cache/all), 24000 steps (the card's fall-back, applied by the G2 smoke of 2026-11-15: 10.4 s per step is above the 9.6 s line for 36000 steps, which would take about 104 h), lr 3e-4 with warm-up 1000, ema 0.999, eval every 3000 steps, model.camera_student evit_b1 from the distillation run t22_A2_s0 (student_init), trainable, student_frames all (every frame of the window from the student: the newest frame with gradient, the older ones under no_grad), the student's own lr 3e-5 with warm-up 3000, its distillation anchor 0.5 falling to ZERO at 0.25 of the steps (student_anchor_floor 0, student_anchor_until 0.25), photometric image jitter from 0.25 of the steps (img_jitter 1.0, img_jitter_from 0.25: the clean image until the anchor is gone), keep_steps = 1/6, 1/3, 2/3 and all of the 24000 steps (4000, 8000, 16000, 24000: the learning curve of one run, read on the 246 CPU frames). Radar memory OFF (frozen by the card), no junction mask in the loss (frozen by the card).
